thread.title: Jim Cramer Breaks Down a Not So-Happy Monday for the Market

author: Home
title: Jim Cramer Breaks Down a Not So-Happy Monday for the Market
text:
Do the markets have more to worry about than a case of the Monday's?
 TheStreet founder and Action Alerts Plus portfolio manager broke down this morning's market action from the floor of the New York Stock Exchange.
Cramer noted that in the current economic environment under Fed chair Jerome Powell, there's simply no reason to buy popular stocks including flailing Dow component Apple ( AAPL ) or Real Money 's stock of the day Home Depot ( HD ) .
"We have kind of the worst of all worlds right now," Cramer said.
